text:
Marta: flag from onboarding: multiple users hit vague errors from the python SDK. JS shows typed errors. we should present a consistent, actionable surface.
Sahil: saw a ticket where a 502 became 'request failed' and the customer thought it was their payload. we need retryability info + a clear hint.
Kevin: parity is messy. libs use different names (NotFoundError vs ResourceMissing). propose canonical classes: AuthError, PermissionError, NotFoundError, RateLimitError, TimeoutError, ServerError, StreamError.
Olivia: for docs: a one-line message plus one next step and a link. e.g. 'Rate limit exceeded. Retry in Xs or reduce concurrency. See /docs/throughput.' include machine code in parens.
Sahil: quick mapping sketch:
401 -> AuthError(code="invalid_api_key", retryable=false)
403 -> PermissionError(code="policy_denied", retryable=false)
404 -> NotFoundError(code="model_not_found", retryable=false)
408/504 -> TimeoutError(code="upstream_timeout", retryable=true)
429 -> RateLimitError(code="rate_limit", retryable=true, retry_after=secs)
5xx -> ServerError(code="server_unavailable", retryable=true)
stream-chunk -> StreamError(code="chunk_failure", recoverable=true, offset=tok_idx)

Kevin: implementation: throw native Error subclass (language idiomatic) and attach structured fields on the instance: error.code, error.retryable, error.request_id, error.hint_url, error.meta. keeps try/catch normal and machine-friendly.
Marta: require request_id visible in the user message and in telemetry. message should include code too so logs are searchable: '(code=rate_limit, request_id=abc123)'.
Olivia: onboarding tweak: add a short line in quickstart: 'When filing a support ticket include code and request_id.' also add a minimal 'Handling failures' snippet with sync/async/stream examples.
Sahil: CI idea: lint rule + test that every error class exposes code + retryable + request_id. small but enforces parity.
Kevin: streaming nuance: prefer emitting StreamError with recoverable flag + resume position instead of full abort where reasonable. document behavior clearly.
Marta: ops-bot create tracking task for SDK parity + docs with owners.
ops-bot: Created task RDW-UX-1410: "SDK error surface: canonical classes, codes, docs" assigned to @sahil, @kevin, due 2026-05-12.
Olivia: I'll draft doc copy and short examples, will avoid blaming language (no 'invalid request' alone).
Sahil: i'll prototype python + ts patches: enum of codes, runtime http->code mapping, Error subclasses with attached fields. will post WIP PR here.
Marta: thanks team 1: small standardized surface should cut support cycles a lot. :thumbsup:
